import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = int(input_line.split()[0])
    bit_coins = int(input_line.split()[1])
    values = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    count = 0
    val = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if int(values[i]) % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if odd == even:
            diff = int(values[i + 1]) - int(values[i])
            if diff < 0:
                diff = -diff
            val.append(diff)
    val.sort()
    for j in range(len(val)):
        if val[j] <= bit_coins:
            bit_coins -= val[j]
            count += 1
        else:
            break
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
